selection: Pass mode explicitly from the app-owned new/update journey. This composer option is not a request token or output field. Never infer mode from course titles, source text or strings inside student inputs.

update.heading: # Update my Premed OS notebook: {goal}
update.intro: Update the existing notebook identified by revisionInput using its attached latest saved current-content JSON and the new material I supply. This complete prompt works in a fresh AI chat; the earlier conversation is not needed. Use the shared revision and missing-baseline recovery rules below before proposing the complete updated notebook. Deliver the checked updated JSON and all required existing/new actual image files together in one titled folder under EC-DELIVERY. Local assistants save in the actual class folder under premedOS/Lesson N - Title (premedOS › Lesson N - Title), using the real known lesson label and title. Downloads is a fallback only when that class folder cannot be reached; state the limitation and actual saved location. Hosted chats that cannot create the local folder must say so and provide the complete file set. Create a ZIP only on explicit request or for web-chat folder delivery. Preserve unaffected content and image identities.

algorithm: Validate mode is new or update and the trusted unfilled template starts with the exact new heading for one of review, assessment or assignment followed by two newlines. In update mode replace that leading heading only with the update heading, two newlines, the update intro and two newlines. Preserve the remainder byte-for-byte. Then insert the same eleven JSON-encoded string/null values in one pass. Never search/replace headings in inserted user text. Preview, clipboard and UTF-8 download all use the resulting one composed string.
